sidebar.Sidebar.category.はじめに.link.gener.message: From installing OverRec to showing the panel in VR and pressing it. Follow the pages in order.

sidebar.Sidebar.category.設定の一覧.link.gene.message: Settings are in two places: the window on the PC (the desktop) and the gear on the panel in VR. Items with the same name are the same setting, wherever you change them.
